blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱525.92 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱18.32 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Friday, Nov. 13, 2026. According to PCSO results, the winning combination for Ultra Lotto 6/58 was 51-50-40-54-57-34, with a jackpot prize of ₱525.92 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 draw produced the winning combination 26-38-37-20-19-28, carrying a jackpot of ₱18.32 million. No bettor won the top prize.
